title.en: An Act to Amend Act Numbered thirty-Eight Hundred and One, Entitled "An Act Granting to the Imus Electric Company, Inc., a Franchise to Install, Operate, and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Bacoor, Province of Cavite, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Act Numbered Thirty-eight hundred and one is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six,
there is hereby granted to the Imus Electric Company, Inc., for a period of fifty years from the approval of this
Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power
system by means of the extension of its electric transmission lines from the municipality of Imus to the
municipality of Bacoor, Province of Cavite, Philippine Islands, for distributing electric light, heat and power
within the limits of said municipality of Bacoor."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 16, 1931.
